lines.text: The LORD tells the people to ask for the ancient paths, but they refuse to walk in them or listen to the watchmen.
The LORD brings disaster because they rejected His instruction, and He says frankincense from Egypt does not please Him.
An army is coming from the land of the north, cruel and merciless, riding upon horses against the Daughter of Zion.
The people's hands hang limp, and they are told to put on sackcloth and roll in ashes as for an only brother.
The refining proceeds in vain because the wicked are not purged, so they are called rejected silver.
